items:
12 On Inlet - NEW GULF VIEW RENOVATION! 30 SECONDS TO THE BEACH!

Modern Amenities Meets Vintage Charm in Small, Quiet Inlet Beach Community. This 2 Bed, 2.5 Bath Townhouse w/Stunning Gulf Views, and Steps to One of the Best Beaches on the Emerald Coast. Nestled in the quaint and quiet neighborhood of Inlet Beach which mixes vintage Florida with modern convenience, this Gulf view, a three-story townhouse is only a 30-second walk to a sugar white beach and emerald green waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Paddle-board or kayak in Lake Powell.

The covered 2-car carport includes an outdoor shower and storage room with a stackable washer/dryer.

The living spaces have been freshly renovated and meticulously designed with numerous unique features and amenities - all with a mid-century modern vibe.
Enter the second floor and find an open concept kitchen and living room with a great pocket view of the Gulf. The kitchen is fully equipped and features dining space for six, stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. The living area is bright, modern, and comfortable. Dine or lounge on the balcony, listen to the waves, feel the breeze, and take in the view. This floor also has a half bath.

Proceed to the third floor upstairs to two bedrooms each with a custom bathroom. The master bedroom features a king bed and a private balcony with more of the great Gulf view. The second bedroom is perfect for couples with children and has a queen bed and twin over twin bunks. Dine and shop in Rosemary Beach or the newly-developed Shops @ Inlet.

* Outdoor Shower - Perfect for rinsing off after a long day of enjoying the beach
* Complimentary Wi-Fi
* Beach chairs and toys
* Full-Size Refrigerator With Ice Maker
* Pots, Pans, & Cooking Utensils Provided

* Easy Beach Access

The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
